release.command: exec bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; if [ -z "${GHCR_TOKEN:-}" ]; then GHCR_TOKEN="$(gh auth token --hostname github.com)"; GHCR_USERNAME="${GHCR_USERNAME:-$(gh api --hostname github.com user --jq .login)}"; export GHCR_USERNAME; fi; export GHCR_TOKEN; exec node downstream/release.mjs --output "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/omniroute-release-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)-$$" --push'
